english: No connection. Check your mobile data or Wi-Fi, then try again.
kinyarwanda: Nta murandasi uhari. Reba interineti ya telefoni yawe cyangwa Wi-Fi, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

english: This is taking too long. Check your mobile data, then try again.
kinyarwanda: Biratinze cyane. Reba interineti ya telefoni yawe, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

english: Our system could not do this just now. Try again in a few minutes.
kinyarwanda: Sisitemu yacu ntiyabashije kubikora ubu. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'iminota mike.

english: We could not find your account. Contact WASAC customer care.
kinyarwanda: Ntitwabonye konti yawe. Hamagara serivisi y'abakiriya ba WASAC.

english: Something in this request was not accepted. Check it and try again.
kinyarwanda: Hari ikitemewe muri ibi wohereje. Bigenzure maze wongere ugerageze.

english: Allow camera access in your browser settings, or upload a photo of your meter.
kinyarwanda: Emerera mushakisha (browser) gukoresha kamera mu igenamiterere ryayo, cyangwa wohereze ifoto ya mubazi yawe.

english: Your photo is saved, so you don't need to take it again.
kinyarwanda: Ifoto yawe yabitswe, ntukeneye kongera kuyifata.

english: You have a photo that was not sent yet. Send it, or take a new one.
kinyarwanda: Ufite ifoto itaroherezwa. Yohereze, cyangwa ufate indi.

english: That file is not a photo. Choose a photo of your meter.
kinyarwanda: Iyo dosiye si ifoto. Hitamo ifoto ya mubazi yawe.

english: We could not read the numbers in this photo
kinyarwanda: Ntitwashoboye gusoma imibare iri kuri iyi foto

english: Wipe the meter glass, make sure there is light, and take the photo closer to the numbers.
kinyarwanda: Sukura ikirahure cya mubazi, urebe ko hari urumuri, maze ufotore wegereye imibare.

english: Live tips are off to save mobile data.
kinyarwanda: Inama zihita zigaragara zahagaritswe kugira ngo uzigame interineti.

english: Live tips have stopped. Take the photo when the numbers are inside the box.
kinyarwanda: Inama zihita zigaragara zahagaze. Fata ifoto igihe imibare iri mu kazu.

english: The meter numbers, cut from your photo
kinyarwanda: Imibare ya mubazi, yakuwe ku ifoto yawe

english: We couldn't find a water meter. Point the camera at the meter's number window.
kinyarwanda: Ntitwabonye mubazi y'amazi. Erekeza kamera ku kazu k'imibare ka mubazi.

english: Try moving a little closer to the meter.
Some numbers may be cut off. Try moving back a little.
kinyarwanda: Imibare imwe ishobora kuba itagaragara yose. Gerageza gusubira inyuma gato.

english: It looks dark. Try turning on a light or using your phone's torch.
kinyarwanda: Harasa n'ahijimye. Gerageza gucana itara cyangwa ukoreshe itara rya telefoni yawe.

english: There may be a reflection. Try tilting the phone slightly.
kinyarwanda: Hashobora kuba hari urumuri rwigaragaza ku kirahure. Gerageza guhengamira telefoni gato.

english: The numbers are hard to see. If the glass is dirty or wet, wipe it gently and try again.
kinyarwanda: Imibare ntigaragara neza. Niba ikirahure cyanduye cyangwa gitose, gihanagure buhoro maze wongere ugerageze.
Reba neza niba imibare ari yo.

english: Point the camera at the meter's numbers and hold still.
kinyarwanda: Erekeza kamera ku mibare ya mubazi, ntunyeganyege.

english: Do these numbers match your meter?
kinyarwanda: Iyi mibare irahura n'iri kuri mubazi yawe?

english: Tap a number to change it.
kinyarwanda: Kanda ku mubare kugira ngo uwuhindure.

english: Type all 8 numbers on your meter: the 5 on black, then the 3 on red.
kinyarwanda: Andika imibare 8 yose iri kuri mubazi yawe: 5 iri ku birabura, hanyuma 3 iri ku mutuku.

english: We read {raw}. Check the numbers on your meter and type them here.
kinyarwanda: Twasomye {raw}. Genzura imibare iri kuri mubazi yawe maze uyandike hano.

english: Check the numbers on your meter and type them here.
kinyarwanda: Genzura imibare iri kuri mubazi yawe maze uyandike hano.

english: Fill in all 8 numbers. If a wheel shows nothing, type 0.
kinyarwanda: Uzuza imibare 8 yose. Niba hari aho nta mubare ugaragara, andika 0.

english: We could not use this reading. Take the photo again, close to the numbers and with good light.
kinyarwanda: Ntitwashoboye gukoresha iki gipimo. Ongera ufotore wegereye imibare kandi hari urumuri ruhagije.

english: A WASAC officer is checking this reading. When they finish, the result will appear in Messages. You don't need to do anything.
kinyarwanda: Umukozi wa WASAC arimo kugenzura iki gipimo. Narangiza, igisubizo kizagaragara mu Butumwa. Nta kindi usabwa gukora.

english: The more water you use in a month, the higher the price for each extra cubic metre. The service charge is the same every month.
kinyarwanda: Uko ukoresha amazi menshi mu kwezi, ni ko igiciro cya buri metero kibe y'inyongera kizamuka. Amafaranga ya serivisi ni amwe buri kwezi.

english: You pay from the MTN Mobile Money number on your account: {phone}.
kinyarwanda: Uzishyura ukoresheje nimero ya MTN Mobile Money iri kuri konti yawe: {phone}.

english: We could not confirm the payment. Check your bills before you try again, so you don't pay twice.
kinyarwanda: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza ubwishyu. Banza urebe fagitire zawe mbere yo kongera kugerageza, kugira ngo utishyura kabiri.

english: No bills yet. Take your first meter photo.
kinyarwanda: Nta fagitire uragira. Fata ifoto ya mbere ya mubazi yawe.

english: Your first bill will appear here once a WASAC officer has checked your reading.
kinyarwanda: Fagitire yawe ya mbere izagaragara hano umukozi wa WASAC namara kugenzura igipimo cyawe.

english: Read your meter to get your next bill.
kinyarwanda: Soma mubazi yawe kugira ngo ubone fagitire ikurikira.

english: A WASAC officer is checking the reading you sent. The result will appear in Messages. You don't need to do anything.
kinyarwanda: Umukozi wa WASAC arimo kugenzura igipimo wohereje. Igisubizo kizagaragara mu Butumwa. Nta kindi usabwa gukora.

english: We noticed higher water use than usual. Read the message to see what to check.
kinyarwanda: Twabonye ko wakoresheje amazi menshi kurusha uko bisanzwe. Soma ubutumwa urebe ibyo ukwiye kugenzura.

english: No messages. We'll tell you here if we notice anything unusual about your water use.
kinyarwanda: Nta butumwa. Tuzakubwira hano nitubona ikintu kidasanzwe ku mikoreshereze yawe y'amazi.
Amazi menshi cyane kurusha uko bisanzwe

english: On {date}, your meter showed much more water than your home usually uses.
kinyarwanda: Ku wa {date}, mubazi yawe yerekanye amazi menshi cyane kurusha ayo urugo rwawe rusanzwe rukoresha.

english: High water use for a while
Your water use has been higher than usual for several readings, up to {date}.
kinyarwanda: Imikoreshereze yawe y'amazi imaze ibipimo byinshi iri hejuru y'uko bisanzwe, kugeza ku wa {date}.

english: A reading lower than the last one
The reading you sent on {date} is lower than your last one. Meters only count up, so we check readings like this.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo wohereje ku wa {date} kiri munsi y'icyaheruka. Mubazi zibara zizamuka gusa, ni yo mpamvu tugenzura ibipimo nk'ibi.

english: Your meter may not be moving
Your meter has shown the same reading for a while, up to {date}. If you use water and the numbers don't change, contact WASAC customer care.
kinyarwanda: Mubazi yawe imaze igihe yerekana igipimo kimwe, kugeza ku wa {date}. Niba ukoresha amazi kandi imibare ntihinduke, hamagara serivisi y'abakiriya ba WASAC.

english: The reading you sent on {date} looks different from your usual water use.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo wohereje ku wa {date} gitandukanye n'uko usanzwe ukoresha amazi.
Reba niba hari aho amazi ava:

english: wet ground or walls near your pipes
kinyarwanda: ubutaka cyangwa inkuta bitose hafi y'amatiyo yawe

english: Leaking water goes through your meter and is on your bill, so fix a leak as soon as you can.
kinyarwanda: Amazi ava anyura muri mubazi yawe kandi abarwa kuri fagitire yawe, bityo kanika aho amazi ava vuba uko ubishoboye.

english: A WASAC officer is checking this reading. You don't need to do anything.
kinyarwanda: Umukozi wa WASAC arimo kugenzura iki gipimo. Nta kindi usabwa gukora.

english: Checked and confirmed. Your bill is ready.
kinyarwanda: Cyagenzuwe kandi cyemejwe. Fagitire yawe yabonetse.

english: We could not confirm this reading. Please read your meter again.
kinyarwanda: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza iki gipimo. Ongera usome mubazi yawe.

english: Read your water meter in a minute.
kinyarwanda: Soma mubazi yawe y'amazi mu munota umwe.

english: Take a photo of your meter, check the numbers, and pay your bill with MTN Mobile Money.
kinyarwanda: Fotora mubazi yawe, genzura imibare, maze wishyure fagitire yawe ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money.

english: Take a photo of the numbers on your meter.
kinyarwanda: Fotora imibare iri kuri mubazi yawe.

english: Check the numbers we read and correct any that are wrong.
kinyarwanda: Genzura imibare twasomye maze ukosore iyo twibeshyeho.

english: See your bill and pay it with MTN Mobile Money.
kinyarwanda: Reba fagitire yawe maze uyishyure ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money.

english: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
kinyarwanda: Igihe cyawe cyo kwinjira cyarangiye. Ongera winjire.

english: Too many wrong attempts. Wait 5 minutes, then try again.
kinyarwanda: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi zitari zo. Tegereza iminota 5, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

english: Someone has already dealt with this. Refresh to see the latest.
kinyarwanda: Undi muntu yamaze kubikemura. Ongera ufungure urupapuro urebe ibigezweho.

english: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
kinyarwanda: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi mu gihe gito. Tegereza umunota umwe, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

english: This photo is too large. Take a new photo, or choose a smaller one.
kinyarwanda: Iyi foto ni nini cyane. Fata indi foto, cyangwa uhitemo nto.

english: For WASAC billing and field staff. Review held readings and follow up on households.
kinyarwanda: Ni iy'abakozi ba WASAC bashinzwe fagitire n'abo mu murima. Genzura ibipimo byahagaritswe kandi ukurikirane ingo.

english: That username and password do not match. Check them and try again.
kinyarwanda: Izina n'ijambo ry'ibanga ntibihura. Bigenzure maze wongere ugerageze.

english: Forgot your password? Ask your supervisor to reset it.
kinyarwanda: Wibagiwe ijambo ry'ibanga? Saba umuyobozi wawe kurihindura.
Harimo aho amazi ashobora kuba ava

english: Search by name, meter or sector
kinyarwanda: Shakisha ukoresheje izina, mubazi cyangwa umurenge

english: {count} readings are waiting. Check each one against the household's usual use.
kinyarwanda: Ibipimo {count} bitegereje. Gereranya buri kimwe n'imikoreshereze isanzwe y'urugo.

english: Keys: J next, K previous, A accept, R reject, U undo.
kinyarwanda: Utubuto: J ikurikira, K ibanziriza, A emeza, R anga, U subiza inyuma.

english: The meter photo is not stored with readings yet.
kinyarwanda: Ifoto ya mubazi ntabwo iracyabikwanwa n'ibipimo.

english: Reject, ask for a new photo
Accepting creates the bill. Rejecting asks the household, in Messages, to send a new photo.
kinyarwanda: Kwemeza bikora fagitire. Kwanga bisaba urugo, binyuze mu Butumwa, kohereza indi foto.

english: Accepted the reading for {name}. Bill created: {amount}.
Rejected the reading for {name}. They will be asked for a new photo.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo cya {name} cyanzwe. Bazasabwa kohereza indi foto.

english: No readings are waiting for a decision. New held readings appear here.
kinyarwanda: Nta bipimo bitegereje icyemezo. Ibipimo bishya byahagaritswe bizagaragara hano.

english: Check the address, or go back to the start.
kinyarwanda: Genzura aderesi, cyangwa usubire aho watangiriye.
